components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action; indigo fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3730a3; color: #fff; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5850c8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,.15); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.13); transition: background .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f4f1; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #dc2626; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; border: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,.2); transition: background .12s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(220,38,38,.08); }

components.name: Diagram Card
components.description: Gallery card for a saved org chart.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07); border-radius: 14px; transition: box-shadow .18s, transform .18s, border-color .18s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.1); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(0,0,0,.13); } .ds-card-body { padding: 13px 15px 14px; } .ds-card-body h3 { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 4px; color: #111111; } .ds-card-body p { font-size: 12px; color: #999999; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field for forms and node properties.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 7px 9px; background: #f5f4f1; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #111111; transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3730a3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,.1); }

components.name: Org Node
components.description: The signature component: a person card on the org-chart canvas.
components.css: .ds-onode { border-radius: 14px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07); background: #ffffff; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; transition: box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1); } .ds-onode:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-onode strong { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; } .ds-onode span { font-size: 12px; color: #555555; }

narrative.overview: OrgChart Editor exists so a manager can build something they'll put in front of leadership without worrying whether the tool made them look unpolished. The metaphor is a whiteboard in a well-lit room: a quiet, neutral surface where the one thing that matters — the chart itself — gets all the attention. Indigo (#3730a3) is the single confident marker color, used sparingly and always on purpose (a primary action, a selected node, a brand mark). Everything else stays out of the way: warm-neutral surfaces, restrained shadows, no competing saturated colors. This system explicitly rejects generic SaaS visual language: gradient-text heroes, cream/sand near-white backgrounds pretending to be warm, hero-metric templates, tiny uppercase eyebrows above every section, and numbered section markers used as decoration rather than a real sequence.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (indigo), used deliberately and rarely
Warm-neutral surfaces (#f0efeb family), never generic cream/sand-as-default
Soft, shallow shadows for lift — never heavy or dark-mode-2014
Geist throughout: confident but not shouty typography
Full light/dark parity on every surface

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears on primary actions, selection, and brand marks only. If a screen has more than one saturated color competing for attention, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Unification Rule
rules.body: The product has exactly one background family (#f0efeb warm neutral) and one accent (#3730a3 indigo). index.html's warmer #fafaf7 background and editor.html's blue #3b82f6 accent are drift, not intentional variation.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second typeface family. Every hierarchy level is Geist at a different weight/size.

rules.name: The Ambient-Not-Heavy Rule
rules.body: Shadow opacity never exceeds ~0.2 alpha in light mode. If a shadow reads as a hard drop-shadow rather than soft depth, the blur radius is too small or the alpha too high.

dos: Do use indigo (#3730a3) as the only saturated brand accent, and use it sparingly.
Do keep the base background at #f0efeb (light) / #1d2125 (dark) across every surface.
Do use soft, shallow shadows for lift; widen and soften on hover rather than darken.
Do use Geist at varying weight/size for the entire type hierarchy; never introduce a second family.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on any new animation.
Do keep amber (tool-active state) and blue/amber/green (focus/multi-select/connect-target rings) as the only sanctioned exceptions to the one-accent rule.
donts: Don't use #fafaf7 as a background anywhere outside legacy marketing copy.
Don't use editor.html's blue #3b82f6 as the primary accent.
Don't use gradient-text headlines, cream/sand-as-default backgrounds, hero-metric templates, uppercase eyebrows above every section, or numbered section markers as decorative scaffolding.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't let shadow alpha exceed ~0.2 in light mode.
Don't add bounce/elastic easing to anything except the dropdown-open transition.
Don't introduce a second typeface family for variety.
